answer: Before the first answer, the identity proves it spent compute: a delay proof bound to the epoch seed, taking near a minute per key and verifiable in a blink. An operator spinning up 610 aliases must run 610 separate delays, since each proof is chained to its own key and cannot be shared; the tundra of that binding is what stops resale, the vine of the public log is what stops reuse, and the pigment of the waiting time is what makes a thousand fakes cost a thousand minutes.
